title: Stasis Corn Army
description: A surreal fantasy scene shows a giant floating baby's head with wide terrified eyes and open mouth, labeled 'STASIS' above and 'INDUSTRIAL' on a banner below. An elven woman in ornate silver armor and golden headdress stands on an icy cliff holding a glowing orb, facing an army of armored rat soldiers riding war elephants through a purple flower field with glowing orbs. Corn stalks grow on the left while colorful magical smoke rises in the background.
